cost_basis: API-equivalent USD, including Main and all workers; not the subscription bill.
score_notice: Scores are the agents’ own assessments and may not be reasonable or objective.

quality.notice: Agent assessment; not an objective quality standard.
quality.tcp: Both explain opening and closing sequence numbers, normal states, half-close, TIME-WAIT and RST. Skill has additional security context.
quality.cache: Both compare capabilities, choice, cache-aside and miss handling. Workflow adds a workload checklist; Skill is more explicit about asynchronous replication loss and stale-cache remedies.
quality.git: Both show graphs, moved references, new commit IDs, fast-forward, conflict commands and shared-history caution. Skill additionally explains squash, rebase-merges, skipped or empty commits and reflog recovery.

reuse.quality: HTML and MP4 bytes and decoded audio are identical.
